title: 요일과 날짜: 오늘, 내일, 월요일
objective: By the end, you can understand words like 오늘, 내일, 어제, 월요일 and 주말, and use them to say when something happens in short sentences.
summary: Learn ten basic words for talking about days and dates, such as today, tomorrow, Monday and the weekend.

task.title: Use the time words
task.line: Read each sentence, then choose, fill in, or write the time word that fits.

words.exampleMeaning: I'm not going to work today.
I watched a movie with a friend yesterday.
What day of the week is it today?
I have Korean class on Monday.
Are you free on Friday evening?
What are you doing on the weekend?
I'm a little busy this week.
I have a test next Tuesday.

exercises: Choose the right word: ① (어제 / 내일) 백화점에 갔어요. ② (어제 / 내일) 백화점에 갈 거예요.
Choose the right word: ① 이번 주는 시간이 없어요. (이번 주 / 다음 주)에 만나요. ② (월요일 / 주말)에는 회사에 안 가요. 집에서 쉬어요.
Fill in the blank with one word from the list: A: 여행 ____가 언제예요? B: 5월 3일이에요.
Fill in the blank with one word from the list: A: 무슨 ____에 수업이 있어요? B: 월요일하고 금요일에 있어요.
Write in Korean: ① I am busy today. ② See you on Monday.
answers: ① 오늘 바빠요. (오늘은 바빠요.) ② 월요일에 만나요. (월요일에 봐요.)
